title: Sand Script
subtitle: Let gravity finish the sentence.
description: Pour five earthy pigments into a cellular sand tray. Build walls, erase channels, and rearrange authored vessels, hourglasses, and terraces; every grain settles cell by cell and every edit has an undo.
instruction: Choose sand, wall, or erase and drag in the tray. Use Space and arrows to draw by keyboard; Undo restores the previous moment.
